name: @revenant/engine
description: Revenant engine: scan npm dependency graveyards and resurrect abandoned packages.

scripts.sample: tsx src/cli.ts scan ../../samples/cursed --transitive 12 --out ../../apps/web/public/samples/cursed.scan.json && tsx src/cli.ts resurrect ../../apps/web/public/samples/cursed.scan.json moment --from ../../samples/cursed --out ../../apps/web/public/samples/moment-to-dayjs.json && tsx src/cli.ts resurrect ../../apps/web/public/samples/cursed.scan.json request --from ../../samples/cursed --out ../../apps/web/public/samples/request-to-fetch.json && tsx src/cli.ts resurrect ../../apps/web/public/samples/cursed.scan.json uuid --from ../../samples/cursed --out ../../apps/web/public/samples/uuid3-to-randomuuid.json
